name: Sweet Stuff
source:
For fifty years humankind has been migrating all over the universe. Ricks visits training school as a candidate for captain of a space ship. And with time and encounters he begins to touch the hearts of pilot candidate girls...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人類已經在宇宙各處遷徙了50年。里克斯來到訓練學校，成為一名太空船船長候選人。

隨著時間流逝，一次次的相遇讓彼此熟悉，他也開始觸及那些女飛行員候選人的內心……

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
